key_idea: Read the sticks from the bottom up and find the one in the middle.
steps: From the bottom up, the sticks are: 5, 1, 4, 7, 2, 3, 6.
There are 7 sticks. The middle one has 3 sticks under it and 3 sticks on top of it.
Stick 7 has 5, 1 and 4 under it, and 2, 3 and 6 on top of it. So stick 7 is in the middle.

choice_feedback.A: Stick 1 is 2nd from the bottom. Only stick 5 is under it.
choice_feedback.B: Stick 2 is 3rd from the top. 4 sticks are under it.
choice_feedback.C: Stick 4 is 3rd from the bottom. Only 2 sticks are under it.
choice_feedback.D: Stick 5 is at the very bottom.
